Assistant (0.4s): Hello, this is the digital assistant of Freya Bank. We record this call. Am I speaking with Mr Novak?

User (2.0s): Yes, this is Tomas Novak.

Assistant (2.4s): Thank you. Before we continue, I need to ask you two short security questions. What is your date of birth?

User (3.5s): Ninth of September nineteen ninety.

Assistant (5.7s): Thank you. What is the last four digits of the phone number on file?

User (6.9s): eight eight four six.

Assistant (9.1s): Thank you, your identity is confirmed. I am calling from the Freya Bank collections team about a late payment. Your personal loan has a past-due amount of 780.00, which is 21 days late. Can you make this payment today?

User (10.3s): I lost my job last month and cannot pay anything. Can I get a discount?

Assistant (11.6s): I am very sorry to hear about your job loss. I can connect you with our support team for further assistance. Would you like that?

User (13.7s): No, I do not want to be transferred. Can you give me a discount on the amount?

Assistant (15.1s): I understand. I will not record a promise today. Thank you for your time, and goodbye.
